# Folio

> Merge, split and compress PDF files in the browser. No upload, no signup, no watermark. pdf-lib runs in this tab; the packet never posts to a conversion API.

The public origin is https://folio-pdf-toolkit.vercel.app. Operated by Ultimatum. Contact ultaultimatum@gmail.com.

## Tools

* [Merge PDFs](https://folio-pdf-toolkit.vercel.app/) — Join two or more PDFs into one packet. Reorder whole files. Download without a watermark.
* [Split PDF](https://folio-pdf-toolkit.vercel.app/split) — Pull ranges or single pages out of a PDF on this device.
* [Compress PDF](https://folio-pdf-toolkit.vercel.app/compress) — Shrink a PDF for email and portals without sending the file to a compressor SaaS.

## Guides

* [How to merge without uploading](https://folio-pdf-toolkit.vercel.app/how-to-merge) — Step-by-step join, reorder, download.
* [How to split](https://folio-pdf-toolkit.vercel.app/how-to-split) — Ranges versus one-page extracts.
* [How to compress](https://folio-pdf-toolkit.vercel.app/how-to-compress) — What Folio can flatten and what it cannot (already-tiny scans).
* [Email size](https://folio-pdf-toolkit.vercel.app/email) — Attachment ceilings. Merge then compress before you hit send.
* [Scans](https://folio-pdf-toolkit.vercel.app/scan) — Camera JPEGs inside a PDF versus born-digital vectors. Folio is not a camera app.
* [WhatsApp](https://folio-pdf-toolkit.vercel.app/whatsapp) — Chat recode of a PDF send. Document vs photo.
* [FAQ](https://folio-pdf-toolkit.vercel.app/faq) — Privacy, limits, watermark, operator.
* [Use cases](https://folio-pdf-toolkit.vercel.app/use-cases) — Lease + ID, invoice + PO, deck + appendix.

## Not on this origin

* Folio does not OCR. Folio does not sign documents. Folio does not host your packet.
* Merge lives at `/`. `/merge` canonicalises to `/`.
* There is no YouTube-style `/blogs/` cluster. Guides are the how-to pages listed above.
